_comment: Runtime profile (D31, D37-RUNTIME-2): all the data the engine needs about one tool; engine code holds no runtime name (D37-RUNTIME-1). A user may add or replace a profile in <user dir>/runtimes/; a project never can (D37-FLOW-8). In argv lists, {session_id}, {model} and {title} are filled in by the engine; {prompt} becomes the prompt file's text when the session starts. In path patterns, {home}, {config_dir}, {skill}, {plugin} and {name} are filled in. Checked against claude --help: -p, --session-id, --resume, --permission-mode (plan is read-only) and auth status. Not yet exercised by a real run: skill_call, session_log, limits and plugin_skill_paths.
title: Claude Code
limits: The subscription usage endpoint gives five_hour and seven_day utilization with their reset times.
install: install Claude Code (https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/setup), then log in with: claude auth login
